issues.text: Unlisted claim, and wrong: outbox rows do not wait for another program. They wait for OutboxRelay, a hosted service inside DonHang.Api itself (Program.cs:43-44 "OutboxRelay, a hosted service in this process"; OutboxMessage.cs:4-5 "a message waiting in the sender's own database until OutboxRelay has handed it to RabbitMQ"). The lesson's own next paragraph says OutboxRelay is in DonHang.Api. Not in any claim.
issues.quote: The row goes to `outbox_messages`: rows waiting for another program to pick them up.
issues.fix: Replace with: "The row goes to `outbox_messages`: rows waiting to be passed on after the save." If a ledger entry is wanted, add it to claim 5 or 14: "outbox_messages rows wait in DonHang.Api's database until OutboxRelay, in the same process, passes them on (OutboxMessage.cs:4-5)."

Line 37 `AddCatalogModule(...)` registers Catalog's products, Redis and cache (ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs:10-11 "Products, Redis and their cache are the Catalog module's own registrations"), and :47-48 AddRabbitMq/AddOutboxRelay. The repo comment scopes it to Ordering: "The one call Program.cs makes to get Ordering's repositories, outbox, event handlers and DbContext registered".

issues.fix: Replace with: "the method `Program.cs`, the composition root, calls to register the order side's infrastructure classes" (or "Ordering's" if that module name is in known vocab).

issues.text: "outbox" is not in what I know and is not in Core concepts, yet three names are built on it: `IOutbox`, `outbox_messages`, `OutboxRelay`. The sentence tells me what `IOutbox` does, so I can follow, but I stop on why stage-3 moved the email row from `notifications` to a new table with this name.

issues.fix: Add half a sentence after "not `notifications`" saying in known words what `outbox_messages` holds (rows waiting for another program to pass them on after the save), and that the outbox lesson in Connections explains the name.

issues.text: "passes the row on": on to what? At stage-2 the sender read the `notifications` table itself. Here `OutboxRelay` passes the row somewhere and then `DonHang.Notifications` sends the email, but I cannot reconstruct how the row gets from one to the other. Quiz q6 option b leans on this step.
issues.quote: After the save, `OutboxRelay`, a hosted service in `DonHang.Api`, passes the row on, and `DonHang.Notifications`, a separate program that replaces stage-2's `NotificationSender`, sends the email.
issues.fix: Either name where `OutboxRelay` passes the row in one clause, or say openly: "how the row travels from `OutboxRelay` to `DonHang.Notifications` is the next lesson's topic; here it matters only that it starts after the save."
